newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia '97 budget provides 1 pct industrial growth.
newsitem.headline: Russia '97 budget provides 1 pct industrial growth.

text.p: Russia's 1997 budget provides for one percent industrial production growth after a fall of about four percent this year, Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin said on Tuesday.
Production growth in gas, coal, timber, pulp, food and light industries will be even higher than one percent, he told a news conference.
Russian officials have long said 1997 would be the first year with a growth in industrial output.
So far this year, industrial production has fallen about five percent compared to 1995, while the government predicted a three to four percent fall for the whole year, Yasin said.
